queries.query: "large language model" AND ("network operations" OR NetOps OR "network configuration" OR "network change")
queries.rationale: Locate primary literature that applies LLMs directly to NetOps problems (configuration synthesis, intent translation, change planning).

queries.query: (LLM OR "large language model" OR "foundation model") AND (hallucinat* OR incorrect* OR unsafe) AND ("network configuration" OR NetOps OR "network change")
queries.rationale: Find documented failure modes (hallucinations, incorrect actions) when LLMs are applied to network configuration and operational tasks.

queries.query: ("generate-validate-repair" OR "generate-then-verify" OR "generate-and-repair" OR "generate\u2013validate") AND (network OR NetOps OR "network configuration") AND (Batfish OR "header space" OR HSA OR verifier OR verification)
queries.rationale: Survey architectures that combine generation with formal/empirical validators and automated repair loops for network configs.

queries.query: ("tool-assisted" OR "tool use" OR "tool-augmented" OR Toolformer OR ReAct OR LangChain) AND (LLM OR "large language model") AND (network OR NetOps OR "network automation")
queries.rationale: Identify methods where LLMs invoke external tools/APIs/verifiers for safer NetOps workflows and orchestration patterns for agents.

queries.query: (agentic OR "autonomous agent" OR "autonomous NetOps" OR "agentic AI") AND (network OR NetOps OR "network management")
queries.rationale: Collect work on autonomous/agentic systems applied to network management, their decision architectures, and safety considerations.

queries.query: ("AIOps" OR "NetOps benchmark" OR "network operations benchmark" OR "6G-Bench" OR "TSNBench" OR "OpsEval" OR "OWL")
queries.rationale: Find existing benchmark suites and task collections used to evaluate ML/LLM systems in AIOps/NetOps and inspect their scope and validity.

queries.query: Batfish AND ("network verification" OR "configuration analysis" OR reachability OR policy)
queries.rationale: Locate technical descriptions, evaluations, and use-cases of Batfish and similar network-verification engines used as validators for configs.

queries.query: ("Header Space Analysis" OR HSA OR NetPlumber OR Veriflow OR Anteater OR Verigraph) AND (network OR verification OR reachability)
queries.rationale: Retrieve foundational formal methods and practical tools for network verification that can serve as oracles/validators for generated configs.

queries.query: ("network emulation" OR testbed OR Mininet OR NS-3 OR Emulab) AND (LLM OR "network automation" OR NetOps)
queries.rationale: Identify emulation/testbed platforms commonly used to evaluate NetOps actions and how they can be integrated into model-in-the-loop experiments.

queries.query: ("constrained decoding" OR "controlled generation" OR "lexical constraints" OR "constrained sampling") AND (LLM OR "large language model")
queries.rationale: Survey decoding/constraint techniques to enforce syntactic/semantic constraints on generated configurations as a mitigation strategy.

queries.query: ("self-correction" OR "self-critique" OR "self-repair" OR "generate-and-verify" OR "self-consistency") AND (LLM OR "large language model") AND (network OR NetOps OR configuration)
queries.rationale: Find methods where LLMs iteratively critique/repair their outputs or use internal verification loops to reduce errors in operational outputs.

queries.query: ("network change" OR "configuration change" OR "change verification") AND (safety OR correctness OR rollback OR "change validation")
queries.rationale: Locate work specifically on validating planned network changes, rollback strategies, and safety checks for change execution.

queries.query: ("human-in-the-loop" OR "operator-in-the-loop" OR "human oversight") AND (NetOps OR "network operations" OR "LLM")
queries.rationale: Survey human oversight paradigms, hybrid workflows, and decision thresholds for operator intervention in automated NetOps pipelines.

queries.query: ("network configuration dataset" OR "router configuration" OR "config corpus" OR "network configs dataset")
queries.rationale: Discover publicly available corpora of real/simulated network configurations suitable for training or evaluating LLMs and validators.

queries.query: ("agentic AI" OR "autonomous agents") AND (safety OR verification OR "trustworthiness") AND (policy OR governance)
queries.rationale: Broaden to agentic AI safety literature relevant to trust, verification, and governance of autonomous NetOps agents.

queries.query: ("evaluation metric" OR "metric" OR "oracle" OR "validation") AND (NetOps OR "network configuration" OR AIOps)
queries.rationale: Identify and critique metrics and oracles used to judge correctness/operational validity (reachability, policy compliance, performance regressions).

queries.query: (LLM OR "large language model" OR "foundation model") AND (benchmark OR evaluation) AND (AIOps OR NetOps OR "network operations")
queries.rationale: Collect papers that evaluate LLMs in operational contexts and analyze their experimental designs and limitations to inform validity questions.

queries.query: (misconfiguration OR outage OR "network incident" OR "config error") AND (case study OR postmortem OR "root cause")
queries.rationale: Gather operational incident analyses caused by configuration errors to ground realistic failure modes and threat models for NetOps automation.
source_preferences: operator postmortems (GitHub/companies' blogs with technical detail)

inclusion_criteria: Peer-reviewed conference/journal papers and workshop proceedings where available.
ArXiv/preprints and technical reports with reproducible methods and accessible artifacts.
Publicly accessible tool/documentation repositories (e.g., Batfish, Mininet, NS-3) and benchmark/dataset project pages (GitHub, Zenodo).
Datasets, benchmarks, and code distributions that are open or have clear provenance and versioning.
Operator-authored technical postmortems or incident reports that provide technical root-cause analysis.
Works in English or with reliable English translations.
Papers/tools that explicitly address at least one of: generation, verification, validation, mitigation, or evaluation for NetOps or closely related infra automation tasks.
exclusion_criteria: Pure marketing materials, press releases, or vendor high-level blogs lacking technical methods or verifiable artifacts.
Proprietary datasets, internal incident reports, or closed-source tool internals that cannot be inspected or reproduced.
Papers that only evaluate generic LLM QA on isolated networking trivia without operational task framing (e.g., pure exam-question benchmarks).
Works outside the NetOps/AIOps/Network verification neighborhood unless they provide transferable technical methods (these may be captured via targeted agentic/AI-safety queries).
Non-verifiable claims lacking code, dataset, methodology, or primary-source citations.
date_rationale: Prioritize literature from ~2018	62026 for LLM/AIOps/agentic-LLM advances (LLM and agentic AI developments accelerated since 2019	62023). Include seminal or foundational network-verification and configuration-analysis work from earlier (2004	62018) because formal methods (HSA, NetPlumber, Veriflow, Batfish origins) predate modern LLMs and are essential validators. Recent (last 3 years) preprints and tool releases are critical for up-to-date mitigation and benchmark discussions.
